name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna.
description: Under this scheme, Directorate of Higher Education, scholarship is applicable for the economically weaker sections. The student’s those who have taken an admission for Professional and Non-Professional courses which come Under Directorate of Higher Education Government /Non-government aided/Partially Aided -Unaided/Permanent Unaided College and Non-Agricultural Universities and Sub-Centers (Excluding Private Universities / Self-financed Private Universities).
department: Higher and Technical Education ,Maharashtra State ,Scheme implemented by Technical Education,M.S , Mumbai
implementingAuthority: Higher and Technical Education ,Maharashtra State ,Scheme implemented by Technical Education,M.S , Mumbai

evidence.quote: 1. Applicant should be Domicile of Maharashtra.

criteria.label: 2. For professional courses, Applicant should be a child of registered labor , child of Alpabhudarak or both as total annual income of family/ Guardian should not be more than 8.lakh.

evidence.quote: 2. For professional courses, Applicant should be a child of registered labor , child of Alpabhudarak or both as total annual income of family/ Guardian should not be more than 8.lakh.

criteria.label: 3. For Non Professional Courses, applicant should have upto 1 lakh family Annual Income.

evidence.quote: 3. For Non Professional Courses, applicant should have upto 1 lakh family Annual Income.

criteria.label: 4. Applicant should submit Family Annual Income Certificate.

evidence.quote: 4. Applicant should submit Family Annual Income Certificate.

criteria.label: 5. As per Government Resolution first two children eligible for scheme.

evidence.quote: 5. As per Government Resolution first two children eligible for scheme.

criteria.label: 6. Candidates are eligible those who have taken an admission under general category and SEBC Category.

criteria.label: 7. Courses by GR 07/10/17 (DHE courses) can apply.

criteria.label: 8. Applicant should be hosteller.(Govt/Private hostel/ Paying Guest/ Tenant.)

evidence.quote: 8. Applicant should be hosteller.(Govt/Private hostel/ Paying Guest/ Tenant.)

criteria.label: 9. Applicant should not avail any other Nirvah Bhatta benefit.

evidence.quote: 9. Applicant should not avail any other Nirvah Bhatta benefit.

criteria.label: 10. Courses approved by (Govt/AICTE,PCI/COA/MCI/NCTE/University etc ) are eligible.

evidence.quote: 10. Courses approved by (Govt/AICTE,PCI/COA/MCI/NCTE/University etc ) are eligible.

criteria.label: 11. During course, candidate should not have a gap of 2 years.

criteria.label: 12. Applicant should attempt every semester or annual exam.

renewal:
1. Last year, students availed scholarship, He/She can apply for the renewal Scholarship.
2. To Renew the application, the students should use an application ID, The list published on website of www.dhepune.gov.in, Higher Education Directorate.
applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
